caption: The drawing shows a metal container, possibly a tin box, with a hinged lid that is partially open. The container is mostly dark in color, appearing black or very deep green, and it has a looped handle on top of the lid. The surface of the tin is decorated with colorful floral and fruit motifs that include shades of red, yellow, and green, as well as a yellow basket near the bottom center. The lid also has a painted yellow-green leaf or floral design. There is a locking mechanism on the front of the box, and the interior is shadowed and dark, barely showing any details. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present, and the artist’s signature is visible near the bottom left of the image.
title: Painted Toleware Box
